payload.text: ST0011/02 (WP02b), from the consumer inventories via vc (2026-10-31): the candidate ref goes to the project's GitHub remote only, found by its URL against release.repo, never cfg_release_first_remote's answer (a first remote can be a push-only mirror where no CI runs); the tag on green goes to every remote in release.remotes; the candidate ref and the tag are each pushed once per distinct URL, remotes deduplicated by URL and never twice to one repository (two remotes can name one GitHub URL); a remote leg's pair lives under tmp/release/legs/<name>/ (D62) and is never copied into the local record directory (WP05's rule); with the absent leg word and the WSL note queued in ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/st11-wp01/handover/STATE.md.
